# How to Write A Good Note

<p>I barely focus on reading a single paragraph on this book, due to how many jargon I encountered. I'm writing this so I can remind myself on how to write a good note, so I can remind myself what are the context I'm trying to remember instead of reading the whole chapter again.</p>

<p>Getting a recommendation from GPT, where I think it would spark my excitement to learn something new, here are what I think I should do after learn something new on it:</p>

1. Write a single or more than one sentence a short definition of what I just learn.
2. Think of examples that similar to what you learn.
3. Make it relate to something you mainly want to study about.
4. Do an active learning, by writing a short experiment of it.

<p>I think instead of reading, but moving to finding examples, seek a correlation with I mainly learn about, and finally doing active learning is a solution. By doing this, I can grasp quickly and not getting bored quickly.</p>
